component.name: Project Ember
component.summary: Reversible warmth and software dimming for every display

description.p: Project Ember reduces short-wavelength display output and provides software dimming on Hyprland, Sway and X11. Every display is identified independently, its original state is journaled before the first write, and restores are verified.
Sun schedule calculates sunrise and sunset on-device. Ember performs no network requests and requires no accounts, telemetry or tracking.
